Avery 5160 Label Maker

Generate printable US Letter Avery 5160, 5163, and A4 address label sheets directly from CSV. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Parses uploaded CSV contact spreadsheets and formats standardized Avery 5160 (30 address labels per sheet), Avery 5163 (10 large shipping labels per sheet), or A4 grid templates. Automatically calculates CSS page print breaks and padding to align precisely with physical adhesive sticker sheets.

How to use

  1. Upload a spreadsheet CSV file containing customer names, physical mailing addresses, or inventory SKU numbers.
  2. Choose your target template standard (Avery 5160 30-up, Avery 5163 10-up, or A4 standard 24-up).
  3. Select which specific spreadsheet column contains the destination text to print on the label cells.
  4. Click Generate Printable Sheet and download your standalone print-ready HTML document.

Limits & Considerations

Formats plain text strings into standardized label cells. Does not render custom QR barcodes or embedded graphical corporate logos.

Privacy & Security

Your customer spreadsheets and confidential mailing lists are parsed purely via client-side JavaScript. Private data never leaves your personal workstation.
